QUOTE: The library creates no threads. `pthread_create` appears only in `programs/ssl/ssl_pthread_server.c`, which is an example.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the library creates no threads, but it never says the library supplies the mutex abstraction (threading layer) for threaded callers. It only describes the mutex layer as compiled out by default and lists which locks are used when THREADING_C is on.
